text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! I'm feeling pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While all of the results are yet to be
revealed, I
consider this a significant
step forward!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I mustn't forget to express my thanks to
you,
either, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thank you from the bottom of my heart
for your
diligent work as my test subject
day in and day
out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thank you from the bottom of my heart
for your
diligent work as my test subject
day in and day
out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, how kind of you to say that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But I want you to properly accept my
gratitude
first.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's put in our best effort so that our
work
continues to pay off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Our research has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And we cannot afford to slack off. You
seem to
understand this well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's continue at this pace to expand our

potential and surpass the limits of

Umamusume-kind!
